title: Quick, Mustardy Thai Nectarines Khao Pad
description: A fast and flavorful Thai dish featuring nectarines, mustard seeds, and lotus leaves. This recipe is a plant-based twist on a traditional Thai recipe.

ingredients.name: Nectarines
ingredients.notes: ripe but slightly firm, cut into wedges

ingredients.name: Mustard seeds
ingredients.notes: black mustard seeds or brown mustard seeds work well

ingredients.name: Lotus leaves
ingredients.notes: fresh or dried, wrapped in lotus leaves for serving

ingredients.name: Garlic
ingredients.notes: minced and sautéed with the ginger paste

instructions: Heat the coconut oil in a large skillet over medium-high heat.
Add the mustard seeds and cook, stirring frequently, for 1 minute, until fragrant.
Add the ginger paste and garlic and cook, stirring frequently, for 1 minute, until fragrant.
Add the nectarine wedges and cook, stirring occasionally, for 2-3 minutes, until slightly caramelized.
Add the maple syrup and cook, stirring frequently, for 1 minute, until the nectarines are coated.
Transfer the nectarine mixture to the lotus leaves and wrap each leaf into a tight package.
Serve immediately, garnished with chopped scallions.
